title: Apply the obstruction to the whole bank rather than one reflection
statement: The whole common-frame bank E[(P/k)^tensor Q] is an exact CPTP output of Q iid normalized Choi copies. Its fixed-k entropy/concentration bound is Q>=r²[log k-h(e)-e log(k-1)]/(16k²) at half-diamond e<1-1/k; for k=2 it is r²[log(2)-h(e)]/64. Thus task-level collective processing alone cannot remove the quadratic rank bill within this class, but the result does not cover later payload-correlated source calls or every quantum probe profile.
